title: Before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: At 2,200 meters long, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is a medium-distance race just like the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Running the Oaks was really rough on me. Just remembering it is scary…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But Trainer believes I can do this, so I have to do my best!
